{{Short description| Belgian statistician and actuary (born 1939)}}
{{notability|1=Academics|date=April 2023}}
[[File:Jef Teugels 1987.jpg|thumb|Image of Jef Teugels ]]
'''Jozef Lodewijk Maria Teugels''', or '''Jozef L. Teugels''', '''Jef Teugels''' (born February 20, 1939) is a Belgian mathematical statistician and actuary. His main contributions are in [[extreme value theory]], [[stochastic process]]es, and [[Reinsurance|reinsurance theory]].<ref name=interview>{{Cite journal |last=Fisher |first=Nicholas I. |date=2010 |title=A Conversation with Jef Teugels: A Conversation with Jef Teugels |url=https://www.jstor.org/stable/27919862 |journal=International Statistical Review |language=en |volume=78 |issue=3 |pages=419–441 |doi=10.1111/j.1751-5823.2010.00121.x|jstor=27919862 |url-access=subscription }}</ref>

== Education and career ==

Teugels was born in [[Londerzeel]], Belgium and studied at the [[Catholic University of Louvain]], where he received his licentiate in mathematics in 1963. He moved to the US to pursue further study and obtained his MSc in 1966 and PhD in 1967, both at [[Purdue University]], where he was supervised by [[Marcel F. Neuts]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Jozef Teugels - The Mathematics Genealogy Project |url=https://www.mathgenealogy.org/id.php?id=35949 |access-date=2023-04-26 |website=www.mathgenealogy.org}}</ref> He returned to Belgium in the same year and took up a faculty position at [[KU Leuven]], where he was promoted to full professorship in 1973. He remained in Louvain until his retirement in 2004. During this period, Teugels was the chair of the Department of Mathematics from 1970 to 1977 and from 1982 to 1989.<ref name=interview /><ref>{{Cite journal |last1=Beirlant |first1=Jan |last2=Carbonez |first2=An |last3=Schoutens |first3=Wim |last4=Van Assche |first4=Walter |last5=Veraverbeke |first5=Noel |date=2006-02-01 |title=Preface |url=https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S0377042705003511 |journal=Journal of Computational and Applied Mathematics |series=Special Issue: Jef Teugels |language=en |volume=186 |issue=1 |pages=1–3 |doi=10.1016/j.cam.2005.05.014 |issn=0377-0427|url-access=subscription }}</ref>

Teugels was named a distinguished alumnus of Purdue University in 2004.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Purdue University - Department of Statistics - 2004 Distinguished Alumnus Jozef Teugels |url=https://www.stat.purdue.edu/alumni/distinguished_alumni/teugels-04.html |access-date=2023-04-25 |website=www.stat.purdue.edu}}</ref> He was president of the [[International Statistical Institute]] between 2009 and 2011.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2013-04-03 |title=presidentsof the international statistics institute - isi-web.org |url=http://www.isi-web.org/about-isi/history/43-about/about/98-presidents |access-date=2023-04-26 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20130403180341/http://www.isi-web.org/about-isi/history/43-about/about/98-presidents |archive-date=2013-04-03 }}</ref>
